tools.name: create_invoice_spreadsheet
tools.description: Use this when the user wants invoices, bills or receipts put into an Excel spreadsheet. Builds an .xlsx workbook with one row per invoice, one row per line item, a sheet of arithmetic, missing-field and duplicate checks, and totals per currency, and returns a download link that works for 24 hours.

tools.name: check_invoices
tools.description: Use this when the user wants invoices verified without making a file: whether net plus VAT equals the total, whether line items add up, which fields are missing, and which invoices look like duplicates. Returns the findings and totals per currency. Nothing is stored.

tools.name: list_spreadsheet_templates
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a blank Excel template to fill in by hand for invoices, expenses, landlord accounts, CIS deductions or construction and development costs. Returns the available templates with a page describing each and a direct .xlsx link.
